title: Welcome to cardboard
description: A quick tour of the home screen — your recent projects and the create-or-import entry point.

steps.hint: Welcome to cardboard. The home screen is where you switch between projects and start new ones — let's take a quick look.
Your recent projects live here. Click any project to jump back into its scene editor.
Start fresh with a new project or import an existing pack from a URL. Both create a project you can open and start editing right away.
